arabic_text: الدِّينُ النَّصِيحَةُ قُلْنَا: لِمَنْ؟ قَالَ: لِلَّهِ وَلِكِتَابِهِ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلِأَئِمَّةِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَعَامَّتِهِمْ
english_translation: Religion is sincerity. We said: To whom? He said: To Allah, His Book, His Messenger, and to the leaders of the Muslims and their common folk.
question: What is the correct meaning of 'الدِّينُ النَّصِيحَةُ' in this Hadith?

question: In which authentic collection of Hadith is this narration about sincerity recorded?

question: According to this Hadith, what is the primary teaching about the essence of Islam?
